title: Diagonal extraction from nested infinite index sets (Simon 7.2 proof, choice of the subsequence j_r)
statement: Let Q(r, i, j) (r, i, j ∈ ℕ) be an arbitrary relation. Assume that for every r ∈ ℕ and every infinite set J ⊆ ℕ there is an infinite set J' ⊆ J such that Q(r, i, j) holds for all i, j ∈ J'. Then there is a strictly increasing map φ : ℕ → ℕ such that Q(r, φ(r), φ(r+1)) holds for every r ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop), (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ J : Set ℕ, J.Infinite → ∃ J' ⊆ J, J'.Infinite ∧ ∀ i ∈ J', ∀ j ∈ J', Q r i j) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, Q r (φ r) (φ (r + 1))
